title: Falling For Roza – shows
description: Every show, past and upcoming. The website decides by date which ones are upcoming. See content/README.md.

gigs.description: Oldest first. Add new shows at the end.

id.description: Short name for the web address: /live/<id>/. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. "feierwerk-2026". Don't change it once the show is online, or old links break.

placeholder.description: Marks a stand-in show with made-up details. Remove this line once the real details are in. npm run check won't pass while any show is still a placeholder, so none goes online by accident.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-14". If the exact day is unknown (old shows only), "2025-07" or "2025" works too.

time.description: Optional. When we play (or doors), 24h, e.g. "20:30".

event.description: Optional. Festival, contest, tour or stage, e.g. "Emergenza semifinal".

story.description: Optional. A few lines about the night, in our words. Separate paragraphs with an empty line (\n\n).

info.description: Optional. One short line of extra information, e.g. "Doors 19:00 · Free entry".

tickets.description: Optional. Ticket link. Only shown while the show is upcoming.

link.description: Optional. Event page (venue, festival, Facebook event …).

press.description: Optional. An article about the show (newspaper, blog). Shown on the show's page once it has happened.

photos.description: Optional. The first one is the cover. Photos live in assets/gigs/; scripts/optimize-image.sh prepares them (online, the publishing workflow does).

file.description: The photo's path, e.g. "/assets/gigs/strom/cover.webp" (or just "cover.webp" for a file in assets/gigs/<id>/).

alt.description: What's in the photo, for people who can't see it.
